results.desc: "Try again" in blocked state is enabled and a real pointer click fires retryNotifPermission (requestPermissions call count increments)
"Try again" in failed state is enabled and a real pointer click fires syncNativeReminders(force) — schedule() re-attempted
"Turn on notifications" in not_asked state is enabled and a real pointer click fires retryNotifPermission (requestPermissions call count increments)
"Allow exact reminders" in on-exact state is enabled and a real pointer click fires changeExactNotificationSetting (toast observed)
gap between intro sentence and card is consistent across states (8/8 measured)
notifActionBusy DOES reach a genuine async gap and render disabled=true on a live button (proven via a state transition that keeps a button on screen)

INFO (not pass/fail on its own): while genuinely disabled mid-busy, the button is visually IDENTICAL to enabled (opacity 1, same bg, cursor pointer) -- no dimming/spinner, so on the rare occasions this window is wide enough to be seen, a caregiver gets no visual cue anything is happening
INFO: from blocked (permission stays denied), the retry click never visibly disables the button at all -- syncNativeReminders short-circuits before the busy window is wide enough to render
320px width, blocked state: no horizontal overflow in Notifications section
320px width, not_asked state: no horizontal overflow in Notifications section
320px width, on-exact state: no horizontal overflow in Notifications section
320px width, failed state: no horizontal overflow in Notifications section
amber headline text ("not_asked") vs white background computed contrast >= 4.5:1 AA
failed-state body copy freshly read from live DOM contains no stack-trace/jargon leakage
